Rising to prominence in the days after

, Energy Shields project a thin layer of shielding over an individual character or creature. The popularity of Energy Shields sparks a revolution in combat tactics, including a surge in the popularity of melee weapons and non-Energy projectile weapons. Just as the spread of Energy Shields is a response to the prominence of energy weapons, they in turn cause warriors to adjust their tactics to deal with personal Energy Shields.

Energy Shields typically have 5 charges, and Energy Shields can only be activated once per encounter (the stress on the shield generator causes the device to overload otherwise, so the manufacturers build in failsafes to prevent such an occurrence). Each activation consumes one charge and lasts through the end of the encounter. An Energy Shield only protects against weapons that deal Energy damage; a weapon that deals any other type of damage bypasses the shield's SR entirely.
